nodes.label: Brand Personality
nodes.rationale: Premium, Strategic, Intelligent, Clean, Futuristic, Trustworthy, Practical, Business-focused. Indian-origin but globally usable.

nodes.label: Brand Color Palette
nodes.rationale: Deep navy/near-black background, white/soft-grey text, electric blue/violet/emerald accents, optional saffron/gold cultural hint. Avoids neon overuse.

nodes.label: Brand Typography
nodes.rationale: Modern sans-serif (Inter, Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans) for tech-forward legibility. Strong readable headings with subtle tracking.

nodes.label: Brand UI Elements
nodes.rationale: Lucide React icons, Framer Motion micro-interactions, tasteful glassmorphism cards, clean button shapes with subtle glow borders.

nodes.label: Footer Credit Strategy
nodes.rationale: Standard text: 'Website crafted by PixelNiti' linked to https://pixelniti.com â€” elegant, legible, non-intrusive.

nodes.label: Pixel (Brand Name Component)
nodes.rationale: Represents the digital layer: websites, design, interfaces, digital products, visual identity, and user experience.

nodes.label: Niti (Brand Name Component)
nodes.rationale: Sanskrit-origin word representing strategy, planning, business thinking, policy, and structured execution.

nodes.label: Website Objective (Lead Gen & Credibility)
nodes.rationale: Serve as lead generation and credibility engine for PixelNiti while being the target for 'Website crafted by PixelNiti' footer credits on client sites.

nodes.label: Server Components (Default)
nodes.rationale: Used for standard UI, layouts, and data rendering to maximize SEO and minimize JS payload.

nodes.label: Client Components (use client)
nodes.rationale: Used specifically for interactive elements: Framer Motion animations, interactive forms, mobile menu toggles.

nodes.label: GitHub CI/CD Integration
nodes.rationale: Automatic deployments via GitHub integration. Push to main triggers production build on Vercel.

nodes.label: Future CMS Integration
nodes.rationale: src/data/ structure allows easy swapping with Headless CMS (Sanity, Contentful) in the future.

nodes.label: Content Tone of Voice
nodes.rationale: Professional, confident, simple, direct, human. Avoids overused phrases like 'cutting-edge', 'seamless experience', 'leverage synergy'.

nodes.label: Technical SEO Features
nodes.rationale: Semantic HTML, strict heading hierarchy, Next.js Image component, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, JSON-LD structured data.

nodes.label: Footer Backlink Strategy
nodes.rationale: Every client site delivery includes 'Website crafted by PixelNiti' dofollow link to build PixelNiti's domain authority.

nodes.label: Lighthouse Audit Target (90+ Score)
nodes.rationale: Post-deployment requirement: run Lighthouse audit via Chrome DevTools or PageSpeed Insights targeting 90+ across all metrics.
